entities.summary: Andrzej Wolan was a secretary to the Grand Duke of Lithuania and an eminent Calvinist theologian. Volanus was involved with controversy about both Jesuits and the Ecclesia Minor or Polish Brethren. Fausto Sozzini's De Jesu Christi natura (1584) is a reply to Volanus. Andreas Volanus was a theologians & scholars from Poznań (1530, Poznań–1610-01-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
